instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In an outdoor covered training area, the man in the blue tank top and black shorts (R2) stands on the left, throwing a punch with his black boxing glove. The man in the beige t-shirt and black sweatpants (R1) stands on the right, ducking low with his back to the camera to evade the punch. They are sparring under bright, natural daylight.
elements: R2 is the person throwing a punch while R1 is the person evading it
R1 is ducking low to avoid R2's punch rather than punching R2
R2 uses a black boxing glove during the punch
R1 has his back to the camera while ducking
They are sparring in an outdoor covered training area
